rules.name: netting-perf-explain
rules.sql: SELECT c.subportfolio, c.counterparty_parent, count(*) AS open_trades, count(DISTINCT c.security_id) AS securities FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) AND c.subportfolio IS NOT NULL AND c.counterparty_parent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.subportfolio, c.counterparty_parent ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
rules.explain: WITH RECURSIVE s AS ( (SELECT c.subportfolio FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.subportfolio IS NOT NULL AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) ORDER BY c.subportfolio LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT c.subportfolio FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.subportfolio > s.subportfolio AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) ORDER BY c.subportfolio LIMIT 1) FROM s WHERE s.subportfolio IS NOT NULL ) SELECT subportfolio FROM s WHERE subportfolio IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT c.counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) AND c.subportfolio = :p.subportfolio

SELECT DISTINCT si.derivative_type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) AND c.subportfolio = :p.subportfolio AND c.counterparty_parent = :p.counterparty_parent) s JOIN opera.security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = :tenant AND si.business_unit = :bu AND si.security_id = s.security_id

SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, source, trade_date, contract_number, premium, lots_to_be_netted, market_action, group_type, subportfolio, counterparty, deal_status, security_id, contract_month, product_code, currency, derivative_type FROM opera.netting_trade_view c WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) AND subportfolio = :p.subportfolio AND counterparty = :p.counterparty_parent ORDER BY trade_date ASC NULLS LAST, premium ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT DISTINCT c.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) AND c.security_id > '' ORDER BY c.security_id LIMIT 101

expect.reason: the business unit has open trades with a subportfolio and counterparty
loose index scan over tens of subportfolios
derivative types of the worst pair were 3.4 s before the covering index
first page of the security dropdown
